effects: Takes exactly `assets` USDT from the signer into the vault (safeTransferFrom asset, msg.sender, this, assets).
Mints vault shares to `onBehalf`. The share count is previewDeposit(assets), worked out from the vault's stored totals.
Before minting, accrues interest and mints fee shares to the fee recipients. This sets the share price the signer gets.
formats.shown: Deposit <assets> USDT for <onBehalf>, with the share ticker skyMoneyUsdtRiskCapital and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted is not shown; it comes from the vault's stored exchange rate.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets);` uses accrueInterestView() totals from storage. The descriptor has no field for shares, and none is possible from calldata.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. The ticker field already names what is received.

cases.notes: 1 USDT out to the vault is shown exactly. Shares went to 0xdEaD (signer null), which the screen shows plainly, and the reader understood it.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns vault shares from `onBehalf`. The count is previewWithdraw(assets), rounded up from the stored exchange rate.
When msg.sender != onBehalf, spends that many shares of the signer's share allowance from onBehalf.
Sends exactly `assets` USDT from the vault to `receiver`.
Before this, accrues interest and mints fee shares, which changes the burn rate.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly <assets> USDT to <receiver>, with the owner whose shares are used.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned from the owner are not shown; the count comes from the stored exchange rate.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)` then `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 1: 37841.96 skyMoneyUsdtRiskCapital went out from the signer, and no field states it. The reader listed what leaves as 'Unknown'.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the share count. Optionally add a constant field naming the vault share token that gets burned from Owner.

cases.notes: The 37850 USDT in to the signer is shown exactly. The 37841.96 shares burned are not shown, because the amount is derived from storage. The reader guessed that a vault position shrinks.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` vault shares from `onBehalf`, spending allowance when msg.sender != onBehalf.
Sends USDT to `receiver`. The amount is previewRedeem(shares), from the stored exchange rate, with no minimum-out parameter.
Before this, accrues interest and mints fee shares, which lowers the payout per share.
formats.shown: Redeem <shares> skyMoneyUsdtRiskCapital to <receiver>, with the owner. Nothing says that USDT is the asset received.

findings.title: redeem: no field or intent names USDT as the asset paid out to the receiver.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);`. Descriptor redeem fields are only shares/receiver/onBehalf. The deposit format shows a constant ticker, but redeem has no `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker` field. Case 2: the reader was unsure 'What token and how much I will actually receive'.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}, or say 'Redeem {#.shares} for USDT to {#.receiver}'.

findings.title: redeem: the USDT amount received is not shown and has no minimum; it comes from the stored exchange rate.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);`. No min-out argument exists. Case 2: 2000.001252 USDT came in to the signer, and no amount appears on the screen.

cases.notes: The 1999.6396 shares out are shown exactly with the vault ticker. The 2000.001252 USDT in shows only the receiver, with no asset or amount. The reader guessed 'likely USDT'.
